**Bottom line**  
The paper with PMID 39369609 is titled *“Real-world comparative effectiveness of sotorasib versus docetaxel in second line and beyond among patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)”* and reports an observational study of pretreated KRAS G12C-mutated advanced NSCLC patients. A correction notice exists (PMID 39984314) but was retrieved without substantive text, so no corrected content was applied. In the second-line (2L) cohort, sotorasib (N = 102) yielded median OS 10.2 months (95% CI 7.6–16.3) versus docetaxel (N = 58) median OS 6.0 months (4.2–11.0) with mortality HR 0.62 (0.41–0.93); in the 2L + cohort, sotorasib (N = 164) median OS 10.2 months (8.0–14.6) versus docetaxel (N = 116) median OS 7.2 months (5.1–10.6) with HR 0.65 (0.49–0.87) (PMID: 39369609).  

**Confidence:** moderate (observational study; all figures taken directly from the abstract).  

### Exact title, disease population, and study design  
- **Title:** Real-world comparative effectiveness of sotorasib versus docetaxel in second line and beyond among patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) (PMID: 39369609).  
- **Disease population:** Pretreated KRAS G12C-mutated advanced NSCLC patients in a US-based electronic health record-derived de-identified database (PMID: 39369609).  
- **Study design:** Observational comparative effectiveness study using overlap-weighting propensity score methods (PMID: 39369609).  

### Correction status  
- A correction notice exists for PMID 39369609 (PMID 39984314) and was retrieved, but the notice contains no abstract or text, so corrected content was not applied.

**Evidence limitations**  
No simulation, omics, or clinical trial data were requested or provided; the answer relies solely on the observational abstract and its linked erratum notice.
